# Image Paradise Photography — Detailed AI Reference

## Identity
Image Paradise Photography is a wedding photography and videography service based in Veppampattu near Avadi, Tamil Nadu. The business serves Chennai, Tiruvallur, Avadi, Ambattur and other Tamil Nadu locations, with destination coverage by prior arrangement.

## Services
1. Candid wedding photography
2. Traditional wedding photography
3. Wedding videography
4. Pre-wedding photography
5. Bridal portraits
6. Engagement photography
7. Wedding album design

## Published delivery information
Preview selections are stated as available within 24–48 hours. Full edited galleries are stated as typically delivered within 4–6 weeks. Album design and printing may require additional time.

## Booking workflow
